


1. notebooks/mapping_and_QC.Rmd
- map RPFs and RNA-seq reads
- use ribowaltz to generate QC figures

- filter bam files for high quality read lengths

- generate codon use scores for protein coding genes
- Output: results/codon_scores


4. notebooks/codon_use_dTE_genes.Rmd
- Generate plots for dTE genes
- Output: results/codon_usage_dTE
